standards.title: Luminaires - General Requirements and Tests
standards.scope: General safety and performance requirements for luminaires and lighting fixtures, including LED street and highway lighting, covering construction, electrical safety and ingress protection.

standards.title: Luminaires Part 4: Photometric Testing Methods
standards.scope: Test methods for photometric performance of luminaires, including luminous flux, efficacy and light distribution measurement for LED and other light sources.

standards.title: Degrees of Protection Provided by Enclosures (IP Code)
standards.scope: Classification system and test requirements for degrees of protection provided by enclosures of electrical equipment against ingress of solid objects, dust and water (IP ratings such as IP66).

standards.title: Code of Practice for Lighting of Public Thoroughfares
standards.scope: Installation and design requirements for street and highway lighting installations, including pole spacing, mounting height and illumination levels.

standards.title: Code of Practice for Lighting of Public Thoroughfares (Revised)
standards.scope: Revised installation and design requirements for street and highway lighting installations using modern LED sources, including pole spacing, mounting height and illumination levels.

standards.title: Code of Practice for Earthing
standards.scope: Requirements for electrical earthing of equipment and installations to protect against electric shock, relevant to any mains-powered outdoor electrical fixture.

standards.title: Specification for Rotationally Moulded Polyethylene Water Storage Tanks
standards.scope: Requirements for polyethylene water storage tanks for potable water intended for outdoor and residential use, covering capacity, material, wall thickness, UV stabilisation and leak-proof construction.

standards.title: Water Storage Tanks Part 2: Methods of Test
standards.scope: Test methods for water storage tanks including leak-proofness, UV resistance, drop impact and capacity verification.

standards.title: Specification for Polyethylene for its Safe Use in Contact with Foodstuff and Potable Water
standards.scope: Requirements for food-grade and potable-water-grade polyethylene resin used to manufacture containers, pipes and tanks that come into contact with drinking water.

standards.title: Industrial Safety Helmets - Specification
standards.scope: Requirements for protective headgear worn by industrial and construction workers to protect against falling objects and impact, covering shell construction, harness and impact resistance.

standards.title: Industrial Safety Helmets Part 2: Methods of Test
standards.scope: Test methods for impact resistance, penetration resistance and flame resistance of industrial safety helmets.

standards.title: Specification for Centrifugal Pumps for General Purposes
standards.scope: Design, construction and performance requirements for centrifugal pumps used for water supply, irrigation and general industrial purposes.

standards.title: Specification for Centrifugal Pumps for General Purposes (Revised)
standards.scope: Revised design, construction and performance requirements for centrifugal pumps used for water supply, irrigation and general industrial purposes, aligned with current efficiency norms.

standards.title: Centrifugal Pumps Part 3: Performance Testing
standards.scope: Test methods for verifying flow rate, head and efficiency performance of centrifugal pumps.

standards.title: Safety Requirements for Rotating Electrical Machinery
standards.scope: Safety requirements for motors and rotating electrical machinery used to drive pumps and other industrial equipment.

standards.title: Specification for Steel Furniture - School Furniture
standards.scope: Requirements for steel-framed school furniture including desks, benches and chairs used by students in classrooms, covering construction, dimensions, strength, stability and finish.

standards.title: Safety Requirements for Furniture Used by Children and Students
standards.scope: Safety requirements for furniture intended for use by children and students, including edge smoothness, pinch point avoidance and stability under load.

standards.title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel - Specification
standards.scope: Chemical composition and mechanical property requirements for hot rolled steel used in general structural and fabrication purposes including furniture frames.
